name: Apple Sauce
recipe: 1a. Cut the apples into smaller cubes, about 3cm in all dimentions
1b. have the pan on medium heat until it is warm
3. Lower the heat to not burn the butter
4. Add the cinnamon powder, cook for a few seconds
5. Add the apples, sugar and lime
6. Cook while stirring constantly until the apple is soft
7. Place into a seperate bowl and let it cool down
